stem_book: Which graph will show equilibrium condition? (Rate vs Time graphs (a), (b), (c) as drawn in the figure) (a) graph (a) (b) graph (b) (c) graph (c) (d) None of these
key: (c) the graph whose two curves converge and merge at one common constant rate
correct_answer: c graph in which falling forward-rate and rising backward-rate curves merge at one common constant rate
reason: Options are drawings: (a) curves level off at two different rates, (b) curves cross and separate, (c) curves meet and merge.
work: Equilibrium on rate–time plot: r_f and r_b become equal and stay equal -> graph (c).
